Title: Can The Louvre, Paris target an already locked minion?

Messages.Author: Palamedes
Messages.Body:
In the last game we came to a question about The Louvre, Paris.

Can The Louvre, Paris target and lock an already locked minion?

I guess the rule is similar to Puppet Master / Mind Rape (can be played on a locked vampire), but I can't find any obvious ruling to confirm it.

The Louvre, Paris

Unique location.
You can lock this location to lock a Toreador. If you control the Prince of Paris, you can lock this location to lock a minion. Minions can steal this location as a Ⓓ action.

Messages.Author: kschaefer
Messages.Body:
You can always lock a locked thing or unlock and unlocked thing unless card text prevents it.

Compare Mind Numb to Passion.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> kschaefer wrote:
> You can always lock a locked thing or unlock and unlocked thing unless card text prevents it.
